title: Buxar train murder case: Rohit held for kidnapping, ransom and killing
desc: Police arrested the accused over the kidnapping, ransom demand and killing of 21-year-old Nitin Kumar on a moving train. Investigators say the case points to a repeat pattern of impersonation and violent targeting of passengers in the Buxar section.

title: Trump, Xi discuss Middle East war as Iran presses 7-day plan to end fighting
desc: WASHINGTON/UNITED NATIONS (Reuters): US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping turned to the Middle East war at their summit on Friday, as Iran pressed Washington to accept a seven-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and halt regional fighting.
